newsitem.title: JAPAN: EPA says economy gradually but steadily recovering.
newsitem.headline: EPA says economy gradually but steadily recovering.

text.p: Japan's economy is gradually but steadily recovering, Economic Planning Agency Minister Taro Aso told a news conference on Friday.

Aso said he had not changed his assessment of the economy after the Bank of Japan's survey of business sentiment, released on Wednesday, which showed only a modest improvement in business confidence among Japanese manufacturers.
Aso also said there was no need for an extra budget aimed at stimulating the economy, adding the economy appears to be strong enough to be able to manage without an extra budget.

Aso said he thinks it would be difficult to continue special income tax cuts next fiscal year, although no official agreement has been reached within the ruling Liberal Democratic Party and the two parties that are in a loose alliance with it.
